blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Kurt Barbosa and Tachiana Mangin added two silver medals to the Philippines’ taekwondo haul at the Asian Games 2026 on Friday. Barbosa, a former Olympian, fell to Kazakhstan’s Tamirlan Tleules, 16-14, 15-2, in the men’s -58kg final at Toyohashi Gymnasium. Barbosa fought Tleules closely in the opening round but couldn’t complete the comeback, before the Kazakh dominated the second round to secure gold. Mangin, meanwhile, yielded to China’s Ma Jingyue, 2-0, in the women’s -49kg final. It was still a breakthrough campaign for the 18-year-old Mangin, […]...
